name: crank
description: Use a repo-bound visual canvas in Codex, with selections and flow edits linked back to source code.

interface.shortDescription: A source-linked visual workspace for Codex.
interface.longDescription: Open a repository-bound infinite canvas directly in Codex. Inspect real captured screens, select source-linked UI nodes, edit screen flow intent, and hand a bounded change manifest back to Codex. The plugin includes its own windowless capture runtime; Crank.app is not required.
defaultPrompt: Open the Crank canvas for this repository without rescanning.
打开当前仓库的 Crank Canvas，不要重新扫描。
Sync this repository from code and reopen its Crank canvas.
